translations.idiomatic: Penglong, together with his adopted son Chen Liang and others, all died fighting.

sentences.zh: 事聞，加布政使銜，諡忠愍，建專祠。

translations.literal: When report reached the court he was awarded the rank of administrative commissioner, given the posthumous epithet Zhongmin, and a dedicated shrine was built.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court he was awarded the rank of administrative commissioner, given the posthumous epithet Zhongmin, and a dedicated shrine was built.

sentences.zh: 喪車還津，無貴賤皆往吊，哭如私親。

translations.literal: The funeral cart returned to Tianjin. Without distinction of high or low, all went to mourn, weeping as for a private kinsman.
translations.idiomatic: The funeral cart returned to Tianjin. Without distinction of rank, all came to mourn, weeping as for a kinsman of their own.

sentences.zh: 天津祠落成，蠡縣人李某，生致高剛頭，剖心以祭。

translations.literal: When the Tianjin shrine was completed, a certain Li of Li County captured Gao Gangtou alive and disemboweled him to sacrifice his heart.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tianjin shrine was completed, a certain Li of Li County captured Gao Gangtou alive and cut out his heart as an offering.

sentences.zh: 子澄好為小詩，工駢體文，為政有聲，卒以殺賊致殞。

translations.literal: Zicheng enjoyed composing short poems and was skilled at parallel prose. His governance had renown, yet he finally perished through killing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Zicheng enjoyed composing short poems and was skilled at parallel prose. His governance won renown, yet he finally fell while killing rebels.

sentences.zh: 人謂賊自河北經山西，所至席捲無堅城，獨受挫於子澄，使京師得以為備，其關係尤重雲。

translations.literal: People said that bandits, coming from Hebei through Shanxi, swept everywhere with no strong city able to hold. Only before Zicheng did they suffer defeat, enabling the capital to prepare its defenses. The connection was especially weighty indeed.
translations.idiomatic: People said the rebels, marching from Hebei through Shanxi, swept all before them and no walled city held firm. Only before Zicheng did they suffer defeat, giving the capital time to prepare its defenses—a connection of the utmost importance indeed.

sentences.zh: 先是賊過臨洺關，同知周憲曾公服坐餉鞘上，罵賊死。

translations.literal: Earlier when bandits passed Linming Pass, Vice Prefect Zhou Xian once sat in official robes on a supply convoy wagon and cursed the bandits, dying at their hands.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the rebels passed Linming Pass, Vice Prefect Zhou Xian sat in official robes on a supply wagon and cursed the rebels until they killed him.

sentences.zh: 後子澄以知縣死直隸者：江安瀾，廣西臨桂人。

translations.literal: Later among those who died as magistrates in Zhili after Zicheng: Jiang Anlan, a native of Lingui, Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Later, among magistrates who died in Zhili after Zicheng: Jiang Anlan, a native of Lingui in Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 舉人，挑教職，保知縣，發直隸，補柏鄉。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate, selected for educational post, recommended for magistrate, dispatched to Zhili, appointed to Baixiang.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate, he was selected for an educational post, recommended for magistrate, dispatched to Zhili, and appointed to Baixiang.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，調靜海。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Jinghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he was transferred to Jinghai.

sentences.zh: 賊北犯，靜海為畿南衝要，大軍援剿，供應無乏。

translations.literal: When bandits invaded northward, Jinghai was a strategic point south of the capital. The great army came to relieve and suppress. Supplies were never wanting.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels invaded northward, Jinghai was a strategic point south of the capital. The great army came to relieve and suppress, and supplies were never wanting.

sentences.zh: 賊入境，偕署都司潘宗得等擒斬偽司馬陳得旺，大隊麕至，官軍眾寡不敵，遽潰。

translations.literal: When bandits entered the district he, together with acting battalion commander Pan Zongde and others, captured and beheaded the false Sima Chen Dewang. Then a large host swarmed in. Government troops were few against many and could not match them, and suddenly broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels entered the district he, together with acting battalion commander Pan Zongde and others, captured and beheaded the rebel Sima Chen Dewang. Then a large force swarmed in. Government troops were outnumbered and suddenly broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 城陷，赴水死。

translations.literal: The city fell. He entered the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: The city fell. He threw himself into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 破沙河，王衡身中七刃死；

translations.literal: When Shahe was taken, Wang Heng received seven blade wounds and died.
translations.idiomatic: When Shahe fell, Wang Heng took seven blade wounds and died.

sentences.zh: 破欒城，唐盛朝服罵賊，賊縛之柱上死，典史陳虎臣從死。

translations.literal: When Luancheng was taken, Tang Sheng in court robes cursed the bandits. The bandits bound him to a pillar and killed him. Subprefect Chen Huchen died with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Luancheng fell, Tang Sheng in court robes cursed the rebels. They bound him to a pillar and killed him. Subprefect Chen Huchen died with him.

sentences.zh: 又馬雲嵐，慶雲人。

translations.literal: Also Ma Yunlan, a native of Qingyun.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Ma Yunlan, a native of Qingyun.

sentences.zh: 州判。

translations.literal: He was a subprefectural judge.
translations.idiomatic: He was a subprefectural judge.

sentences.zh: 賊犯縣城，率鄉團出禦，被執，不屈死。

translations.literal: When bandits attacked the county seat he led local militia out to resist. Captured, he refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels attacked the county seat he led local militia out to resist. Captured, he refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 子龍文從死。

translations.literal: His son Longwen died with him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Longwen died with him.

sentences.zh: 卹如例，予世職。

translations.literal: Mourning stipends were granted according to regulation, and a hereditary office was given.
translations.idiomatic: Mourning stipends were granted according to regulation, and a hereditary office was awarded.

sentences.zh: 文穎，字魯齋，趙氏，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Ying, courtesy name Luqi, surname Zhao, was a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ying, courtesy name Luqi, of the Zhao clan, was a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 進士，用知縣，發山東，補蒙陰。

translations.literal: A presented scholar, he was appointed magistrate, dispatched to Shandong, and appointed to Mengyin.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi, he was appointed magistrate, dispatched to Shandong, and posted to Mengyin.

sentences.zh: 邑患蝗，兩以文籥神，皆應。

translations.literal: The district suffered from locusts. Twice he prayed to the god with literary charms, and both times it worked.
translations.idiomatic: The district suffered from locusts. Twice he prayed to the deity with written charms, and both times it worked.

sentences.zh: 調陽信，弭抗漕釁。

translations.literal: Transferred to Yangxin, he quelled disturbances over resistance to grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Yangxin, he quelled disturbances over resistance to grain transport.

sentences.zh: 又調商河，濬徒駭河，境免積潦。

translations.literal: Again transferred to Shanghe, he dredged the Tuhe River and the district was spared accumulated flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred again to Shanghe, he dredged the Tuhe River, sparing the district from accumulated flooding.

sentences.zh: 時粵匪已竄直隸之建通鎮，去商河百里，募練鄉勇，民恃無恐。

translations.literal: At the time Cantonese bandits had already fled to Jiantong Town in Zhili, a hundred li from Shanghe. He recruited and drilled local militia, and the people relied on this without fear.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Taiping rebels had already fled to Jiantong Town in Zhili, a hundred li from Shanghe. He recruited and drilled local militia, and the people took heart.

sentences.zh: 調省主糧台事，適股匪入東境，金鄉、鄆城皆陷，而陽穀當其衝。

translations.literal: Transferred to the provincial capital to manage the supply depot, just as scattered bandits entered the eastern border. Jinxiang and Yuncheng both fell, and Yanggu lay in their path.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to the provincial capital to manage the supply depot just as scattered rebels entered the eastern border. Jinxiang and Yuncheng both fell, and Yanggu lay directly in their path.

sentences.zh: 大吏以文穎有幹才，檄令往署，至則城備久弛，急號召鄉團為守禦計。

translations.literal: High officials, seeing Wen Ying had ability, ordered him to go and serve in acting capacity. When he arrived the city defenses had long been neglected. He urgently summoned local militia to plan defense and holding firm.
translations.idiomatic: Senior officials, recognizing Wen Ying's ability, ordered him to serve as acting magistrate. When he arrived the city defenses had long been neglected. He urgently summoned local militia to organize the defense.

sentences.zh: 是時將軍善祿擁重兵駐東昌，飛牒請援，置不應。

translations.literal: At the time General Shanlu held heavy troops stationed at Dongchang. Urgent dispatches requesting relief were sent but received no response.
translations.idiomatic: At the time General Shanlu held heavy troops at Dongchang. Urgent dispatches requesting relief went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 憤極，抵案曰：「死耳，復何言！」

translations.literal: Furious beyond bearing, he struck the desk and said: "Death only—what more is there to say!"
translations.idiomatic: Furious beyond bearing, he struck the desk and said: "Death is all—what more is there to say!"

sentences.zh: 或諷以出城待援者，怒斥曰：「與城俱存亡，豈有臨難苟免之文某哉？」

translations.literal: When someone hinted that he should leave the city to await relief, he angrily rebuked them: "I live and die with the city. Could there be a Wen who, facing danger, seeks to save himself?"
translations.idiomatic: When someone suggested he leave the city to await relief, he angrily rebuked them: "I live and die with the city. Could there be a Wen who flees in the face of danger?"

sentences.zh: 未幾，賊大至，割半袖付僕馳報父母，即懷印上城，與典史徐鳳喈從容出印相視。

translations.literal: Before long bandits arrived in force. He cut half a sleeve and gave it to a servant to gallop and report to his parents. Then clasping the seal he mounted the wall and calmly with subprefect Xu Fengjie took out the seal and looked at each other.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the rebels arrived in force. He cut off half a sleeve and sent a servant galloping to inform his parents. Then, seal in hand, he mounted the wall and calmly showed the seal to subprefect Xu Fengjie.

sentences.zh: 賊入城，怒馬馳入賊隊，被七創，罵不絕口死。

translations.literal: When bandits entered the city he angrily galloped his horse into the bandit ranks. He received seven wounds and died cursing without cease.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels entered the city he galloped angrily into their ranks. He received seven wounds and died cursing without cease.

sentences.zh: 鳳喈及教官李文綬同遇害。

translations.literal: Fengjie and instructor Li Wenshou were killed together with him.
translations.idiomatic: Fengjie and instructor Li Wenshou were killed together with him.

sentences.zh: 文穎抵任才五日，時咸豐四年二月二十九日。

translations.literal: Wen Ying had been in office only five days. It was the twenty-ninth day of the second month of the fourth year of Xianfeng.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ying had been in office only five days. It was the twenty-ninth day of the second month of the fourth year of Xianfeng.

sentences.zh: 事聞，優恤，立專祠，予世職。

translations.literal: When report reached the court exceptional mourning stipends were granted, a dedicated shrine was built, and a hereditary office was given.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court he received exceptional mourning stipends, a dedicated shrine was built, and a hereditary office was granted.

sentences.zh: 文穎嘗過泰山，題句有云：「此行不了封侯業，原把頑軀竊比君。」

translations.literal: Wen Ying once passed Mount Tai and inscribed a line saying: "This journey shall not complete the achievement of enfeoffment as marquis; I originally compare my stubborn body in secret to you."
translations.idiomatic: Wen Ying once visited Mount Tai and inscribed a line: "This journey will not fulfill the marquisate I sought; I mean to offer this stubborn body of mine, like yours."

sentences.zh: 蓋以泰山自矢，見危授命，其志素定雲。

translations.literal: Presumably taking Mount Tai as his pledge, facing peril and accepting fate—his resolve had long been fixed indeed.
translations.idiomatic: He had taken Mount Tai as his pledge—to face peril and accept fate. His resolve had long been fixed indeed.

sentences.zh: 子四，三爾豐，自有傳。

translations.literal: He had four sons. The third, Erfeng, has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: He had four sons. The third, Erfeng, has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 張積功，江蘇儀徵人。

translations.literal: Zhang Jigong was a native of Yizheng, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jigong was a native of Yizheng in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 舉人。

translations.literal: He was a provincial graduate.
translations.idiomatic: He was a provincial graduate.

sentences.zh: 大挑知縣，發山東，歷州縣吏。

translations.literal: Selected in the grand nomination for magistrate, dispatched to Shandong, he served as magistrate in various prefectures and districts.
translations.idiomatic: Selected in the grand nomination for magistrate and dispatched to Shandong, he served in various prefectures and districts.

sentences.zh: 二十年，初權臨淄。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he first held acting authority over Linzi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was first given acting authority over Linzi.

sentences.zh: 前政不善，多流亡，以誠招徠之，皆歸故業。

translations.literal: The previous administration was poor and many fled. With sincerity he summoned them back and all returned to their former occupations.
translations.idiomatic: The previous administration had been poor and many had fled. With sincerity he summoned them back, and all returned to their former occupations.

sentences.zh: 即墨饑民滋擾，檄往辦理而定。

translations.literal: Hungry people in Jimo grew increasingly unruly. He was ordered by dispatch to go handle the matter and settled it.
translations.idiomatic: Hungry people in Jimo grew increasingly unruly. Dispatched to handle the matter, he settled it.

sentences.zh: 朝城民變，民聞積功治臨淄事，即首行館請死，喻以理，懲以法，皆歡呼去。

translations.literal: The people of Chaocheng rose in revolt. Hearing of Jigong's governance of Linzi, they went straight to the travel lodge and begged for death. He instructed them with reason and punished them by law, and all departed cheering.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Chaocheng rose in revolt. Hearing of Jigong's governance in Linzi, they went straight to his lodging and begged for death. He reasoned with them and punished the guilty by law, and all departed cheering.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年三月，賊攻臨清州，積功適知州事，守禦十四晝夜。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year of Xianfeng bandits attacked Linqing Prefecture. Jigong happened to be in charge of prefectural affairs and held in defense for fourteen days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year of Xianfeng rebels attacked Linqing Prefecture. Jigong happened to be in charge of affairs and held the defense for fourteen days and nights.

sentences.zh: 十四日，城陷，闔門死難。

translations.literal: On the fourteenth day the city fell. His entire household died in the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: On the fourteenth day the city fell. His entire household perished in the disaster.

sentences.zh: 初，賊過冠縣，知縣傅士珍自經死。

translations.literal: Earlier when bandits passed Guan County, Magistrate Fu Shizhen hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when rebels passed through Guan County, Magistrate Fu Shizhen hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 典史瞿濬，字菊坪，江蘇武進人。

translations.literal: Subprefect Qu Jun, courtesy name Juping, was a native of Wujin, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Subprefect Qu Jun, courtesy name Juping, was a native of Wujin in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 帥鄉勇出敵，遇賊城闉，中鳥槍，洞其肋，墜馬。

translations.literal: Leading local militia out to fight the enemy, he encountered bandits at the city gate. Hit by a musket, the ball pierced his ribs and he fell from his horse.
translations.idiomatic: Leading local militia against the enemy, he encountered rebels at the city gate. A musket ball pierced his ribs and he fell from his horse.

sentences.zh: 欲退保於司獄，賊追及，刃倳其胸，罵不絕口，剖腹死之。

translations.literal: He wished to retreat and hold at the prison office, but bandits caught up. Blades pierced his chest. Cursing without cease, they disemboweled him and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: He tried to retreat and hold at the prison office, but rebels caught up. Blades pierced his chest. Cursing without cease, they disemboweled him and killed him.

sentences.zh: 妻呂氏，罵賊，被寸磔。

translations.literal: His wife, née Lü, cursed the bandits and was executed by slow slicing.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, née Lü, cursed the rebels and was executed by slow slicing.

sentences.zh: 亦全家遇害，時三月朔也。

translations.literal: His entire family also met calamity. It was the first day of the third month.
translations.idiomatic: His entire family also perished. It was the first day of the third month.

sentences.zh: 冒芬，江蘇如皋人。

translations.literal: Mao Fen was a native of Rugao, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Fen was a native of Rugao in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 巡檢，發廣東，補北寨司巡檢，調五斗口。

translations.literal: He served as sub-prefectural inspector, was dispatched to Guangdong, appointed sub-prefectural inspector at Beizhai, and transferred to Wudoukou.
translations.idiomatic: He served as a sub-prefectural inspector, was dispatched to Guangdong, appointed inspector at Beizhai, and transferred to Wudoukou.

sentences.zh: 緝獲盜匪傅敏南、烏石姊等，有能名。

translations.literal: He captured and seized bandits Fu Minnan, Wushi Jie, and others, and gained a reputation for ability.
translations.idiomatic: He captured the bandits Fu Minnan, Wushi Jie, and others, earning a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 擢廣州府經歷，調海豐縣丞。

translations.literal: He was promoted to assistant prefect of Guangzhou Prefecture and transferred as assistant magistrate of Haifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to assistant prefect of Guangzhou Prefecture and transferred to serve as assistant magistrate of Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 英吉利擾廣州，以守城功進知縣，授開平縣。

translations.literal: When the English disturbed Guangzhou, he was promoted to magistrate for merit in defending the city and was appointed to Kaiping County.
translations.idiomatic: When the English harassed Guangzhou, he was promoted to magistrate for his defense of the city and appointed to Kaiping County.

sentences.zh: 縣介新會、鶴山間，盜賊出沒，芬嚴為條約，捕甚多。

translations.literal: The county lay between Xinhui and Heshan, where bandits came and went. Fen strictly established regulations and captured very many.
translations.idiomatic: The county lay between Xinhui and Heshan, where bandits came and went. Fen strictly established regulations and captured a great many of them.

sentences.zh: 歷權高要、曲江、乳源等縣。

translations.literal: He successively served in acting capacity as magistrate of Gaoyao, Qujiang, Ruyuan, and other counties.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as acting magistrate of Gaoyao, Qujiang, Ruyuan, and other counties.

sentences.zh: 餘匪吳煥中、黃老滿等潛聚曲江龍歸墟，結連羅鏡墟凌十八，圖复逞。

translations.literal: Remaining bandits Wu Huanzhong, Huang Laoman, and others secretly gathered at Longgui market in Qujiang, linked with Ling Shiba of Luojing market, and plotted to reassert themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Remaining bandits Wu Huanzhong, Huang Laoman, and others secretly gathered at Longgui market in Qujiang, joined forces with Ling Shiba of Luojing market, and plotted to rise again.

sentences.zh: 煥中潛至乳源，為邏者獲。

translations.literal: Huanzhong secretly reached Ruyuan and was captured by patrol scouts.
translations.idiomatic: Huanzhong slipped into Ruyuan and was captured by patrol scouts.

sentences.zh: 芬訊得實，偕千總張鷹揚馳往，捕獲黃老​​滿等頭目十三名，解經曲江寺前村，猝與羅鏡賊遇。

translations.literal: Fen examined him and learned the facts. Together with company commander Zhang Yingyang he rushed there, captured thirteen leaders including Huang Laoman, and while escorting them through Siqian Village before Qujiang Temple suddenly encountered Luojing bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Fen examined him and confirmed the facts. Together with company commander Zhang Yingyang he rushed there and captured thirteen leaders including Huang Laoman. While escorting them through Siqian Village before Qujiang Temple, they suddenly encountered Luojing bandits.

sentences.zh: 鷹揚所部潰散，芬率親軍百餘人與賊戰，軍火盡，芬被創，賊奪黃老滿去。

translations.literal: Yingyang's unit broke and scattered. Fen led more than a hundred personal troops to fight the bandits. When ammunition was exhausted Fen was wounded, and the bandits seized Huang Laoman away.
translations.idiomatic: Yingyang's unit broke and scattered. Fen led more than a hundred personal troops to fight the bandits. When their ammunition ran out Fen was wounded, and the bandits carried off Huang Laoman.

sentences.zh: 芬裹創為書，上總督葉名琛，極言兩粵賊勢急，宜聯絡官民，早繕備具。

translations.literal: Fen bandaged his wounds and wrote a memorial to Governor-General Ye Mingchen, strongly stating that bandit strength in the two Guang provinces was urgent and that officials and people should be united and preparations completed early.
translations.idiomatic: Fen bandaged his wounds and wrote to Governor-General Ye Mingchen, urgently warning that bandit power in the two Guang provinces was critical and that officials and people should be united and defenses readied without delay.

sentences.zh: 越數日，傷劇卒。

translations.literal: Several days later his wounds worsened and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later his wounds worsened and he died.

sentences.zh: 卹如例，後建專祠。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were conferred according to precedent, and a special memorial shrine was later built.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were granted according to precedent, and a special memorial shrine was later built.

sentences.zh: 施作霖，浙江蕭山人。

translations.literal: Shi Zuolin was a native of Xiaoshan, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Zuolin was a native of Xiaoshan in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，用知縣，發陝西。

translations.literal: A selected tribute student, he was appointed magistrate and dispatched to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: A selected tribute student, he was appointed magistrate and dispatched to Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，粵賊竄河南，奉檄督練勇防陝境，署城固縣知縣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng, when Cantonese bandits fled into Henan, he received orders to supervise militia training and defense of the Shaanxi border, and served as acting magistrate of Chenggu County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng, when Cantonese rebels fled into Henan, he received orders to supervise militia training and defend the Shaanxi border, serving as acting magistrate of Chenggu County.

sentences.zh: 七年，河南角子山捻匪擾南陽府，將竄陝，巡撫曾望顏以作霖練勇有紀律，令防商南。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Nian bandits from Jiaozishan in Henan harassed Nanyang Prefecture and were about to flee into Shaanxi. Governor Zeng Wangyan, because Zuolin's militia training had discipline, ordered him to defend Shangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Nian bandits from Jiaozishan in Henan harassed Nanyang Prefecture and were about to flee into Shaanxi. Governor Zeng Wangyan, finding Zuolin's militia well disciplined, ordered him to defend Shangnan.

sentences.zh: 馳抵清油河，距武關三十里，賊已潛由天橋河陷武關，作霖偕候補同知曾兆蓉夜冒風雪抵頭條嶺，擊卻賊前敵。

translations.literal: He rushed to Qingyou River, thirty li from Wuguan Pass. Bandits had already secretly taken Wuguan via Tianqiao River. Zuolin, together with candidate sub-prefect Zeng Zhaorong, braved wind and snow by night to reach Toutiao Ridge and drove back the bandits' advance guard.
translations.idiomatic: He rushed to Qingyou River, thirty li from Wuguan Pass, only to learn that bandits had already secretly taken the pass via Tianqiao River. Zuolin and candidate sub-prefect Zeng Zhaorong braved wind and snow by night to reach Toutiao Ridge and drove back the enemy vanguard.

sentences.zh: 越四道嶺，賊蜂至。

translations.literal: Crossing four mountain passes, bandits swarmed forth.
translations.idiomatic: After crossing four mountain passes, bandits swarmed forth.

sentences.zh: 作霖奮下擊，義勇厲進，作霖手殲悍賊王黨。

translations.literal: Zuolin charged down to strike. Righteous militia pressed forward fiercely. Zuolin personally killed the fierce bandit Wang Dang.
translations.idiomatic: Zuolin charged downhill to attack. Righteous militia pressed forward with fury. Zuolin personally killed the fierce bandit Wang Dang.

sentences.zh: 餘賊卻拒守關，作霖直逼關前，賊復三面撲。

translations.literal: The remaining bandits retreated to hold the pass. Zuolin pressed straight to the pass gate, and bandits again surged from three sides.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining bandits fell back to hold the pass. Zuolin pressed straight to the gate, and the bandits surged at him from three sides.

sentences.zh: 熸賊二十餘騎，賊攻愈猛。

translations.literal: More than twenty mounted bandits were killed, but the bandits' attacks grew fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty mounted bandits were cut down, yet the enemy attacks grew fiercer still.

sentences.zh: 作霖分隊擊，身受重創，力竭死。

translations.literal: Zuolin divided his force and struck. He received grave wounds and died when his strength was exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Zuolin divided his force and counterattacked. He suffered grave wounds and died when his strength gave out.

sentences.zh: 家丁王建、義勇馬永剛等十三人皆死之。

translations.literal: His household steward Wang Jian, righteous militiaman Ma Yonggang, and twelve others all died as well.
translations.idiomatic: His household steward Wang Jian, righteous militiaman Ma Yonggang, and twelve others all died with him.

sentences.zh: 賜卹，諡剛毅，賞世職，建專祠。

translations.literal: Posthumous honors were granted. He was given the posthumous title Gangyi, rewarded with a hereditary office, and a special shrine was built.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumous honors were granted. He received the posthumous title Gangyi (Resolute), a hereditary office, and a special memorial shrine.

sentences.zh: 韓體震，字省齋，河南夏邑人。

translations.literal: Han Tizhen, courtesy name Shenzhai, was a native of Xiayi, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Han Tizhen, courtesy name Shenzhai, was a native of Xiayi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年，捐州吏目，補直隸祁州吏目。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang he purchased appointment as a department clerk and was appointed department clerk of Qizhou in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang he purchased appointment as a department clerk and was posted to Qizhou in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 因父作謀任文安主簿，迴避，補山東德州吏目，捐升知縣。

translations.literal: Because his father Han Zuomou held the post of recorder of Wen'an, he recused himself and was appointed department clerk of Dezhou in Shandong. He purchased promotion to magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: Because his father Han Zuomou served as recorder of Wen'an, he recused himself and was appointed department clerk of Dezhou in Shandong, then purchased promotion to magistrate.

sentences.zh: 以防堵功，獎開缺即選，選湖北通城縣。

translations.literal: For merit in blocking bandits he was rewarded with immediate selection when a vacancy opened, and was selected for Tongcheng County in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: For merit in blocking bandits he was rewarded with immediate selection when a vacancy opened and was assigned to Tongcheng County in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 防堵鄰境要隘出力，保同知。

translations.literal: For effort in defending strategic passes on neighboring borders he was recommended for sub-prefect.
translations.idiomatic: For his efforts defending strategic passes on neighboring borders he was recommended for sub-prefect.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，鄂督官文調赴軍營差委，嗣權孝感縣事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, Hubei Governor-General Guanwen transferred him to army camp duty, and afterward he served in acting capacity as magistrate of Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, Hubei Governor-General Guanwen transferred him to army camp duty, after which he served as acting magistrate of Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 孝感屢經殘破，城缺不完，體震修葺之，招鄉勇城守。

translations.literal: Xiaogan had repeatedly suffered devastation and the city walls were incomplete. Tizhen repaired them and recruited local militia to guard the city.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaogan had repeatedly been devastated and its walls were incomplete. Tizhen repaired them and recruited local militia to hold the city.

sentences.zh: 閏八月，捻匪大股分擾京山、應城一帶，闌入縣境，遂撲縣城。

translations.literal: In the intercalary eighth month a large force of Nian bandits divided to harass the area around Jingshan and Yingcheng, burst into the county territory, and then stormed the county seat.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eighth month a large Nian force divided to harass the Jingshan and Yingcheng region, burst into the county, and stormed the seat.

sentences.zh: 體震與護軍統領舒保善因請入城同守，始解鞍，而賊由缺口入城，體震率勇巷戰，眾寡不敵，身受十傷，刀矛槍子無不備，大呼殺賊而死。

translations.literal: Tizhen and Guard Army commander Shu Baoshan had just been invited into the city to defend together and had barely dismounted when bandits entered through a breach. Tizhen led militia in street fighting. Outnumbered, he received ten wounds—blade, spear, and musket ball alike—and died shouting to slay bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Tizhen and Guard Army commander Shu Baoshan had just been invited into the city to defend together and had barely dismounted when bandits poured in through a breach. Tizhen led militia in street fighting. Outnumbered, he took ten wounds from blade, spear, and musket alike and died shouting to kill bandits.

sentences.zh: 詔照知府例賜卹，給世職。

translations.literal: An edict granted posthumous honors at the prefect rank and a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted posthumous honors at prefect rank and a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 德克登額，字靜庵，滿洲某旗人。

translations.literal: De Kedenge, courtesy name Jing'an, was a Bannerman of a certain Manchu banner.
translations.idiomatic: De Kedenge, courtesy name Jing'an, was a Bannerman of a certain Manchu banner.

sentences.zh: 由筆帖式從將軍都興阿軍，累保至副都統記名。

translations.literal: Starting as a clerical official he followed General Duxing'a's army, and through repeated recommendations rose to listed vice commander of a banner.
translations.idiomatic: Starting as a clerical official he followed General Duxing'a's army and through repeated recommendations rose to listed vice commander of a banner.

sentences.zh: 嘗從攻廣濟，守營壘，不眠者七晝夜。

translations.literal: He once followed the attack on Guangji, holding the camp fort without sleep for seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: He once joined the attack on Guangji and held the camp fort without sleep for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 為人沉靜，溽暑不去長衣，每曰：「賊平即回家授徒，暇則垂釣黑龍江。」

translations.literal: He was quiet by nature. In sweltering heat he never removed his long robe. He often said: "When bandits are pacified I shall go home to teach pupils; in leisure I shall fish on the Heilong River."
translations.idiomatic: Quiet by nature, he never removed his long robe even in sweltering heat. He often said: "When the bandits are pacified I shall go home to teach pupils; in my spare time I shall fish on the Heilong River."

sentences.zh: 又曰：「世受國恩，得一日授命疆場，則吾事畢矣！」

translations.literal: He also said: "Our family has received the state's grace for generations. If I can one day devote my life on the battlefield, then my affairs are complete!"
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "Our family has received the state's grace for generations. If I can one day give my life on the battlefield, then my duty is done!"

sentences.zh: 與體震同守城，城陷，死之。

translations.literal: He defended the city together with Tizhen. When the city fell, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He defended the city together with Tizhen. When the city fell, he died.

sentences.zh: 蔣嘉穀，順天大興籍，浙江山陰山。

translations.literal: Jiang Jiagu was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, and was a native of Shanyin, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Jiagu was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, though his ancestral home was Shanyin in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 以府經歷發貴州，旋保知縣。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Guizhou as a prefectural assistant and was soon recommended for magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He was dispatched to Guizhou as a prefectural assistant and was soon recommended for magistrate.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，署荔波縣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianfeng he served as acting magistrate of Libo County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Xianfeng he served as acting magistrate of Libo County.

sentences.zh: 縣毗連粵西，粵氛近偪，土匪乘之。

translations.literal: The county bordered western Guangdong; Cantonese unrest pressed close and local bandits took advantage.
translations.idiomatic: The county bordered western Guangdong. Cantonese unrest pressed close, and local bandits took advantage.

sentences.zh: 嘉穀內守外禦，境內安堵。

translations.literal: Jiagu defended within and resisted without, and the territory within the borders remained tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu held the interior and resisted from without, and the county remained tranquil.

sentences.zh: 始之任，獄多繁，囚半逆黨脅從，復有挾私誣告人從匪者。

translations.literal: At the start of his tenure cases in the prisons were numerous. Half the prisoners were coerced followers of rebel parties; there were also those who bore private grudges and falsely accused others of joining bandits.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of his tenure the prisons were crowded. Half the prisoners were coerced followers of rebel factions, and some people bore private grudges and falsely accused others of joining bandits.

sentences.zh: 嘉穀訊得實，俱決釋之。

translations.literal: Jiagu examined and learned the facts, and released them all by judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu examined the cases, confirmed the facts, and released them all.

sentences.zh: 時芻糧告匱，或以勸捐進，嘉穀曰：「民被蹂躪久矣，忍朘其生而激變乎？」

translations.literal: At the time fodder and grain were reported exhausted, and some suggested advancing through persuasive levies. Jiagu said: "The people have long been trampled. How can we endure squeezing their livelihood and provoking uprising?"
translations.idiomatic: At the time fodder and grain were reported exhausted, and some suggested raising funds through persuasive levies. Jiagu said: "The people have long been trampled. How can we squeeze their livelihood and provoke rebellion?"

sentences.zh: 事遂寢。

translations.literal: The matter was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 五年六月，水匪复叛，與廣匪合，約五六千人，薄城下，嘉穀募勇五百人擊退之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year water bandits rebelled again, joined with Guangdong bandits, numbering about five or six thousand, and pressed beneath the city walls. Jiagu recruited five hundred militiamen and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifth year water bandits rebelled again and joined Guangdong bandits in a force of about five or six thousand that pressed the city walls. Jiagu recruited five hundred militiamen and drove them back.

sentences.zh: 時土匪遍地，餉需匱乏，嘉穀毀家募勇，妻陸氏亦出钅義釧佐軍，眾感奮，守愈堅。

translations.literal: At the time local bandits were everywhere and supplies were exhausted. Jiagu ruined his family to recruit militia. His wife Lady Lu also contributed bracelets to assist the army. The people were moved to zeal and the defense grew firmer.
translations.idiomatic: Local bandits were everywhere and supplies ran short. Jiagu ruined his family to raise militia, and his wife Lady Lu contributed her bracelets to support the army. The people were stirred to zeal and the defense grew firmer.

sentences.zh: 以故附近州縣皆不保，獨荔波得存。

translations.literal: For this reason nearby prefectures and counties all failed to hold, but Libo alone survived.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason nearby prefectures and counties all fell, but Libo alone survived.

sentences.zh: 十月，賊復至，嘉穀部署城防，誓師出營於水堡，與賊遇，戰捷，賊小卻，後見師乏援，始無忌，麾眾並進。

translations.literal: In the tenth month bandits returned. Jiagu deployed city defenses, swore the troops, and marched out to camp at Shuibao. They encountered bandits, fought successfully, and the bandits fell back slightly. Later seeing the army lacked reinforcements, they ceased to hold back and commanded their masses to press forward together.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the bandits returned. Jiagu deployed the city's defenses, rallied the troops, and marched out to camp at Shuibao. They met the enemy and won an initial victory; the bandits fell back slightly. Seeing the army lacked reinforcements, they lost their caution and surged forward in force.

sentences.zh: 嘉穀鏖戰終日，傷亡略盡，猶裹創刃賊，俄被執。

translations.literal: Jiagu fought fiercely all day until casualties were nearly complete. Still bandaging his wounds he slashed at bandits. Shortly he was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Jiagu fought fiercely all day until his force was nearly wiped out. Still bandaging his wounds, he slashed at the bandits until he was finally captured.

sentences.zh: 賊乘勝攻城，城以有備，卒不破。

translations.literal: Bandits pressed their victory to attack the city, but because preparations had been made the city was not taken in the end.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed their victory to attack the city, but because preparations had been made the city held in the end.

sentences.zh: 嘉穀既陷賊，怒罵不屈。

translations.literal: Once Jiagu fell into bandit hands he cursed angrily and would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: Once Jiagu fell into bandit hands he cursed them furiously and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 賊束薪漬油遍體灼之，死而復甦，甦則罵，罵則復灼，如是數次，乃絕。

translations.literal: Bandits bound kindling soaked in oil and burned him all over. He died and revived; when revived he cursed; when he cursed they burned again. After several such rounds he ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits bound kindling soaked in oil and burned him all over. He died and revived; when he revived he cursed; when he cursed they burned him again. After several rounds of this he perished.

sentences.zh: 貴州巡撫蔣霨遠以嘉穀善政得民，力捍疆圉，被害尤慘。

translations.literal: Guizhou Governor Jiang Weiyuan memorialized that Jiagu had governed well and won the people, stoutly defended the frontier, and suffered especially cruel harm.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou Governor Jiang Weiyuan reported that Jiagu had governed well and won the people, stoutly defended the frontier, and suffered especially cruel harm.

sentences.zh: 奏入，卹世職。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, posthumous honors and a hereditary office were granted.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial reached the throne, posthumous honors and a hereditary office were granted.

sentences.zh: 士請捐建專祠，允之。

translations.literal: The gentry requested to build a special shrine by donation, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The local gentry requested to build a special memorial shrine by public donation, and this was approved.

sentences.zh: 鄧玲筠，字治薌，湖南寧鄉人。

translations.literal: Deng Lingyun, courtesy name Zhixiang, was a native of Ningxiang, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Lingyun, courtesy name Zhixiang, was a native of Ningxiang in Hunan.

sentences.zh: 舉人，

translations.literal: A licentiate.
translations.idiomatic: He was a licentiate.

sentences.zh: 以知縣發貴州。

translations.literal: He was dispatched to Guizhou as a magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: He was dispatched to Guizhou as a magistrate.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢知印江縣，時黔中苗、教匪充斥，匪酋以邪教蠱亂，民有黃號、白號等目，鄉團多叛應之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to magistrate of Yinjiang County. At the time Miao and religious rebels filled central Guizhou. Rebel chiefs used heterodox sects to bewitch and disorder the people; there were Yellow-Label and White-Label groups, and many local militia units rebelled in response.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was promoted to magistrate of Yinjiang County. Miao and religious rebels filled central Guizhou. Rebel chiefs used heterodox sects to bewitch and disorder the people; there were Yellow-Label and White-Label factions, and many local militia units rebelled in response.

sentences.zh: 玲筠銳意​​圖治，週巡轄境，與田更畬叟握手詢利病，手疏小冊，用是能摘發民隱，訟者神之。

translations.literal: Lingyun was keen to govern well. He toured the jurisdiction week by week, shook hands with old farmers in the fields and inquired of benefits and ills, and wrote notes in a small book by hand. By this means he could expose the people's hidden grievances, and litigants regarded him as divine.
translations.idiomatic: Lingyun was determined to govern well. He toured his jurisdiction week by week, shook hands with old farmers in the fields and asked about their hardships and needs, jotting notes in a small book. By this means he exposed hidden grievances, and litigants regarded him with awe.

sentences.zh: 思南賊熾，地連印江，亟行保甲法。

translations.literal: Bandits in Sinan were fierce and the territory connected with Yinjiang, so he urgently implemented the baojia system.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits in Sinan were fierce and the territory bordered Yinjiang, so he urgently implemented the baojia system.

sentences.zh: 單騎詣各鄉，手自敦率，給門牌如式。

translations.literal: Riding alone he went to each village, personally instructed and led them, and distributed door placards in the proper form.
translations.idiomatic: Riding alone he visited each village, personally instructed and led the people, and distributed door placards in the proper form.

sentences.zh: 署紙尾十則：曰忤逆，曰習邪教，曰私結盟黨，曰劫掠，曰藏匪類，曰竊盜，曰容留娼妓，曰賭博，曰鬥毆生事，曰唆訟。

translations.literal: He posted at the paper's end ten prohibitions: on filial impiety, on practicing heterodox sects, on forming secret societies, on plunder, on harboring bandits, on theft, on sheltering courtesans, on gambling, on brawling and causing trouble, and on stirring lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: At the foot of each notice he posted ten prohibitions: filial impiety, practicing heterodox sects, forming secret societies, plunder, harboring bandits, theft, sheltering courtesans, gambling, brawling and causing trouble, and stirring lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 各擇士紳董之，犯者同甲勿與齒。

translations.literal: In each place gentry and scholars were chosen to supervise. Offenders were not regarded as equals by their baojia units.
translations.idiomatic: In each place he chose gentry and scholars to supervise enforcement. Offenders were shunned by their baojia units.

sentences.zh: 改悔者許具狀於各條下，加小印曰「自新」；

translations.literal: Those who repented were permitted to submit written statements under each article, with a small seal reading "self-renewed";
translations.idiomatic: Those who repented were permitted to submit written statements under each article, stamped with a small seal reading "self-renewed";

sentences.zh: 其頑抗及無人敢具保者治之。

translations.literal: Those who stubbornly resisted or for whom no one dared furnish guarantee were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those who stubbornly resisted, or for whom no one dared furnish guarantee, were punished.

sentences.zh: 且計月以驗紳董之能否，加勸懲焉。

translations.literal: Moreover each month he assessed whether the gentry supervisors succeeded, applying encouragement or punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Each month he assessed the gentry supervisors' performance and applied rewards or punishments accordingly.

sentences.zh: 又加意課士，割俸給書院餐錢，與講求正學，並及軍政，士皆畏愛之。

translations.literal: He also paid special attention to instructing scholars, cutting his salary to provide meal money for the academy, expounding orthodox learning together with them, and also touching on military administration. Scholars both feared and loved him.
translations.idiomatic: He also devoted special attention to instructing scholars, cutting his salary to provide meal money for the academy, expounding orthodox learning and even touching on military affairs. Scholars both feared and loved him.

sentences.zh: 勸民修水利，立法詳盡易曉，或親履指示，不以勺水擾民。

translations.literal: He urged the people to repair waterworks, making laws detailed, complete, and easy to understand; sometimes he personally walked the ground to instruct them, never troubling the people over a spoonful of water.
translations.idiomatic: He urged the people to repair waterworks, drafting laws that were detailed, complete, and easy to understand; sometimes he walked the ground himself to instruct them, never troubling the people over a spoonful of water.

sentences.zh: 邪教惑眾，為文告抉摘其謬，婦孺能解。

translations.literal: Heterodox sects deluded the masses; he wrote proclamations exposing their fallacies in language women and children could understand.
translations.idiomatic: Heterodox sects deluded the masses. He wrote proclamations exposing their fallacies in language even women and children could understand.

sentences.zh: 簡壯丁數百，親教之擊刺法。

translations.literal: He selected several hundred sturdy youths and personally taught them thrust-and-cut methods.
translations.idiomatic: He selected several hundred sturdy youths and personally taught them thrust-and-cut fighting.

sentences.zh: 是年十二月，賊陷思南，將犯印江。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of that year bandits took Sinan and were about to invade Yinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of that year bandits took Sinan and were about to invade Yinjiang.

sentences.zh: 印江故無城，出營於雲泮禦賊。

translations.literal: Yinjiang originally had no city walls. He marched out to camp at Yunpan to resist bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Yinjiang had no city walls. He marched out to camp at Yunpan to resist the bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊以書請假道，焚書，斬其人。

translations.literal: Bandits sent a letter requesting passage. He burned the letter and executed the messenger.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits sent a letter requesting passage. He burned the letter and executed the messenger.

sentences.zh: 賊從間道襲治所，玲筠袖銅椎斃三賊。

translations.literal: Bandits took a bypath to raid the magistrate's office. Lingyun kept a bronze mace in his sleeve and killed three bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits took a bypath to raid the magistrate's office. Lingyun kept a bronze mace in his sleeve and killed three bandits.

sentences.zh: 賊環攻，復出銅鐧格鬥，賊莫敢近。

translations.literal: Bandits surrounded and attacked. He drew out a bronze staff to fight hand to hand, and none dared approach.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits surrounded and attacked. He drew a bronze staff and fought hand to hand, and none dared approach.

sentences.zh: 忽四山火起，乃突圍，抵銅仁乞師，得練總王士秀領五百人，一日夜行三百里。

translations.literal: Suddenly fires rose on four mountains. He then broke out, reached Tongren to beg troops, and obtained militia commander Wang Shixiu leading five hundred men. In one day and one night they marched three hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: Suddenly fires rose on four mountains. He broke out, reached Tongren to beg for troops, and obtained militia commander Wang Shixiu with five hundred men. In one day and one night they marched three hundred li.

sentences.zh: 民見玲筠歸，奮躍，復得壯士千餘，仍從至雲泮。

translations.literal: When the people saw Lingyun return they leaped with zeal, rallied more than a thousand stalwart men, and followed him again to Yunpan.
translations.idiomatic: When the people saw Lingyun return they leaped with zeal, rallied more than a thousand stalwart men, and followed him back to Yunpan.

sentences.zh: 是日大霧，人馬對立不相見，譟而進。

translations.literal: That day there was heavy fog; men and horses stood opposite one another without seeing each other. They advanced with shouts.
translations.idiomatic: That day a heavy fog descended; men and horses stood face to face without seeing one another. They advanced with shouts.

sentences.zh: 賊奔，自相蹴蹋，墜崖死者無算。

translations.literal: Bandits fled, trampling one another; those who fell from cliffs and died were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits fled, trampling one another; countless fell from cliffs to their deaths.

sentences.zh: 复追百餘裡，戰中壩，戰螺生溪，戰袁家灣，皆捷。

translations.literal: He pursued again for more than a hundred li, fighting at Zhongba, at Luosheng Stream, and at Yuanjia Bay—all victories.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued for more than a hundred li further, fighting at Zhongba, Luosheng Stream, and Yuanjia Bay—all victories.

sentences.zh: 八年春，知府令玲筠越境勦賊，知府先聞賊畏玲筠，立鄧字旗懾賊，故嚴檄三至。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eighth year the prefect ordered Lingyun to cross the border to suppress bandits. The prefect had earlier heard that bandits feared Lingyun and had raised banners bearing the character Deng to intimidate them, hence the stern dispatch arrived three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eighth year the prefect ordered Lingyun to cross the border to suppress bandits. The prefect had heard that bandits feared Lingyun and had raised banners bearing the character Deng to intimidate them, hence the stern dispatch arrived three times.

sentences.zh: 縣民苦留，玲筠慨然曰：「郡守檄，縣令安敢違？

translations.literal: County people earnestly begged him to stay. Lingyun said with feeling: "A dispatch from the prefect—how dare a county magistrate disobey?
translations.idiomatic: The county people earnestly begged him to stay. Lingyun said with feeling: "A dispatch from the prefect—how dare a county magistrate disobey?

sentences.zh: 且殺賊固​​無分畛域也。」

translations.literal: Besides, killing bandits truly knows no boundary between territories."
translations.idiomatic: Besides, killing bandits knows no boundary between territories."

sentences.zh: 以千三百人往。

translations.literal: He went with thirteen hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: He went with thirteen hundred men.

sentences.zh: 師次分水埡，賊混運糧者入營門，變作，眾驚潰。

translations.literal: The army halted at Fenshui Pass. Bandits mixed in with grain transporters to enter the camp gate, then mutinied. The force panicked and broke.
translations.idiomatic: The army halted at Fenshui Pass. Bandits mingled with grain carriers to enter the camp gate, then mutinied. The force panicked and broke.

sentences.zh: 玲筠親搏戰，飛石中首，手格殺一賊，足後被創，遂及於難，喪其元。

translations.literal: Lingyun fought hand to hand. A flying stone struck his head. He killed one bandit in close combat. His foot was wounded from behind, and he met disaster and lost his head.
translations.idiomatic: Lingyun fought hand to hand. A flying stone struck his head. He killed one bandit in close combat, but his foot was wounded from behind and he met disaster, losing his head.

sentences.zh: 後軍聞失事，憤極，殊死鬥，殺聲與哭聲並，卒奪玲筠屍還。

translations.literal: The rear guard hearing of the disaster was furious beyond measure and fought to the death. The sound of killing mingled with weeping, and in the end they recovered Lingyun's body.
translations.idiomatic: The rear guard, hearing of the disaster, was furious beyond measure and fought to the death. The sound of killing mingled with weeping, and in the end they recovered Lingyun's body.

sentences.zh: 乃樹「忠憤」幟，誓復仇，賊懼，退屯八十里。

translations.literal: They then raised a "Loyal Indignation" banner and swore revenge. Bandits feared this and withdrew to encamp eighty li away.
translations.idiomatic: They raised a "Loyal Indignation" banner and swore revenge. The bandits feared this and withdrew to encamp eighty li away.

sentences.zh: 喪歸，士民大慟，爭致賻賵。

translations.literal: When the funeral procession returned scholars and people grieved greatly and vied to send condolence gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When the funeral procession returned, scholars and common people grieved deeply and vied to send condolence gifts.

sentences.zh: 有負販傭，挈錢四，將運鹽，悉以充賻。

translations.literal: There was a porter who carried goods for hire. He brought four strings of cash and was about to transport salt, but gave it all for condolence gifts.
translations.idiomatic: There was a porter who carried goods for hire. He had four strings of cash and was about to transport salt, but gave it all as a condolence gift.

sentences.zh: 或曰：「如爾家何？」

translations.literal: Someone said: "What will become of your household?"
translations.idiomatic: Someone said: "What will become of your household?"

sentences.zh: 傭哭曰：「公死，吾屬無葬所矣！

translations.literal: The porter wept and said: "When the lord is dead, people like us have nowhere to bury our dead!
translations.idiomatic: The porter wept and said: "When the magistrate is dead, people like us have nowhere to bury our dead!

sentences.zh: 何家為？」

translations.literal: What use is a family?
translations.idiomatic: What does family matter now?

sentences.zh: 民懷其德，立祠祀之。

translations.literal: The people cherished his virtue and built a shrine to worship him.
translations.idiomatic: The people cherished his virtue and erected a shrine in his honor.

sentences.zh: 並刻遺集，曰鉅業堂稿。

translations.literal: They also carved and published his collected writings, called Juye Tang Gao.
translations.idiomatic: They also published his posthumous writings under the title Juye Tang Gao.

sentences.zh: 承順，佟佳氏，漢軍正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Cheng Shun, of the Tongjia clan, was a Han bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Shun, of the Tongjia clan, belonged to the Han Eight Banners' Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 由文生於咸豐四年隨其父甘肅寧夏鎮總兵定安出征湖北，累功擢至通判，發甘肅。

translations.literal: Beginning as a literary licentiate, in the fourth year of Xianfeng he followed his father Ding An, regional commander of Ningxia in Gansu, on campaign in Hubei. Through accumulated merit he was promoted to sub-prefect and dispatched to Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: A literary licentiate, in the fourth year of Xianfeng he accompanied his father Ding An, the Ningxia regional commander in Gansu, on campaign in Hubei. For accumulated merit he rose to sub-prefect and was posted to Gansu.

sentences.zh: 歷權寧夏鹽捕通判、平番縣事，授甘州撫彝通判，所至有聲。

translations.literal: He successively held acting posts as salt-and-bandit sub-prefect of Ningxia and handled affairs of Pingfan County. Appointed Fuyi sub-prefect of Ganzhou, everywhere he served he gained renown.
translations.idiomatic: He served in acting posts as Ningxia's salt-and-bandit sub-prefect and as administrator of Pingfan County, then was appointed Fuyi sub-prefect of Ganzhou. Everywhere he served he won a strong reputation.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，西寧撒回就撫，大吏以貴德廳孤懸大河以外，漢民與番、回雜處，治理不易，檄承順往署。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi, when the Salar Muslims of Xining submitted to pacification, high officials considered Guide Subprefecture isolated beyond the great river, with Han, Tibetan, and Muslim populations intermixed and difficult to govern, and ordered Cheng Shun to go take acting charge.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tongzhi, after the Salar Muslims of Xining accepted pacification, senior officials noted that Guide Subprefecture lay isolated beyond the Yellow River, with Han Chinese, Tibetans, and Muslims living together in hard-to-govern conditions, and dispatched Cheng Shun to take acting charge.

sentences.zh: 適番、回械鬥，承順為之平怨息爭，番、回悅服。

translations.literal: Just then Tibetans and Muslims were fighting with weapons. Cheng Shun settled grievances and quelled the quarrel, and both Tibetans and Muslims submitted gladly.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Tibetans and Muslims were fighting one another. Cheng Shun settled their grievances and restored peace, and both groups submitted willingly.

sentences.zh: 值河州回匪倡亂，甘、涼、寧、肅一帶響應，貴德回民洶洶欲動，承順勸導解散，以被難婦孺置署中別院，撫養數年。

translations.literal: When Muslim rebels at Hezhou raised rebellion and the Gansu, Liangzhou, Ningxia, and Suzhou region responded, the Guide Muslims were stirred and about to rise. Cheng Shun exhorted and guided them to disperse. He placed women and children afflicted by calamity in a separate compound within his yamen and nurtured them for several years.
translations.idiomatic: When Muslim rebels rose at Hezhou and disturbances spread across Gansu, Liangzhou, Ningxia, and Suzhou, the Muslims of Guide grew restless. Cheng Shun counseled them to disperse, placed displaced women and children in a separate compound at his yamen, and raised them for several years.

sentences.zh: 有主者認還，無主者擇配。

translations.literal: Those who had claimants were returned; those without claimants were matched in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: Those with claimants were reunited with their families; those without were given spouses.

sentences.zh: 由是漢、番感戴，回民亦懾其威。

translations.literal: Thereby the Han and Tibetans were grateful, and the Muslims also feared his authority.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the Han and Tibetans were deeply grateful, and the Muslims too stood in awe of his authority.

sentences.zh: 時西寧所屬各廳相繼淪陷，貴德一廳孤立賊中者六年。

translations.literal: At that time the subprefectures under Xining successively fell. Guide alone remained isolated amid rebels for six years.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the subprefectures under Xining fell one after another. Guide alone remained isolated in rebel-held territory for six years.

sentences.zh: 城中回民暗結陝回謀亂，承順密調兵勇入城，嚴為之備。

translations.literal: Muslims within the city secretly colluded with Shaanxi Muslims to plot rebellion. Cheng Shun secretly mustered troops into the city and made strict preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims inside the city secretly plotted with Shaanxi Muslims to rebel. Cheng Shun quietly brought troops into the city and made rigorous preparations.

sentences.zh: 回首馬朵三等率眾千餘人攻城，承順登陴抵禦，砲石雨下，斃賊頗多。

translations.literal: The Muslim chiefs Ma Duosan and others led more than a thousand men to attack the city. Cheng Shun mounted the ramparts to resist. Cannon stones rained down and many rebels were killed.
translations.idiomatic: The Muslim leaders Ma Duosan and others led more than a thousand men against the city. Cheng Shun took to the ramparts in defense. Cannon stones poured down and killed many of the attackers.

sentences.zh: 城內回民開門應賊，城遂陷。

translations.literal: Muslims within the city opened the gates to admit the rebels, and the city then fell.
translations.idiomatic: Muslims inside the city opened the gates to the rebels, and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 承順率勇巷戰，身受重創，厲聲罵賊，賊怒，斷其左臂，罵愈厲；

translations.literal: Cheng Shun led his braves in street fighting. He received grave wounds and shouted curses at the rebels. Enraged, they cut off his left arm; he cursed all the fiercer.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Shun led his militia in street fighting. He was gravely wounded and shouted curses at the rebels. Enraged, they severed his left arm, but his curses grew fiercer still.

sentences.zh: 复斷其右足，罵如故；

translations.literal: Again they cut off his right foot; he cursed as before.
translations.idiomatic: They then severed his right foot, yet he cursed on unchanged.

sentences.zh: 遂斷其首而支解之。

translations.literal: At last they cut off his head and dismembered him.
translations.idiomatic: Finally they cut off his head and dismembered his body.

sentences.zh: 其弟議敘知縣崇順、監生吉順扶其母薩克達氏至屍所哭詈，皆遇害。

translations.literal: His brothers Chongshun, a magistrate by memorial recommendation, and Jishun, an enrolled student, supported their mother Lady Sakda to the corpse and wept and cursed. All were murdered.
translations.idiomatic: His brothers Chongshun, a recommended magistrate, and Jishun, an enrolled student, helped their mother Lady Sakda to the body, weeping and cursing. All were killed.

sentences.zh: 家丁李文忠等七名，同時死之。

translations.literal: Seven household retainers including Li Wenzhong died at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: Seven household servants, including Li Wenzhong, died with them.

sentences.zh: 事聞，卹贈道銜，給世職。

translations.literal: When report reached the court, he was posthumously granted circuit-intendant rank and awarded a hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, he was posthumously honored with circuit-intendant rank and granted a hereditary office.

sentences.zh: 貴德士民復以死事狀赴都申訴，御史吳可讀疏言：「青海辦事大臣玉通疏報，祗及承順被害情形，猶惑於當時'回眾拘集漢民、勒寫官偪民反，漢、回同謀戕官'之說，後經查覆，於精忠大節，仍未述及。

translations.literal: The gentry and people of Guide again submitted a report of his death to the capital in appeal. Censor Wu Kedu memorialized: 'The Qinghai commissioner Yutong reported in his memorial only the circumstances of Cheng Shun's murder, still misled by the contemporary claim that "Muslims gathered Han people, forced them to write that officials had driven the people to rebel, and Han and Muslims jointly murdered the official." Later investigation overturned this, yet his supreme loyalty and great integrity were still not described.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people of Guide again petitioned the capital with an account of his death. Censor Wu Kedu memorialized: 'Commissioner Yutong of Qinghai reported only the circumstances of Cheng Shun's murder, still misled by the contemporary claim that Muslims had gathered Han people, forced them to write that officials had driven the people to rebel, and that Han and Muslims together murdered the official. Later investigation overturned this, yet his supreme loyalty and integrity were still not described.

sentences.zh: 在承順為國捐軀，光明俊偉，於原遂矣。

translations.literal: As for Cheng Shun's offering his life for the state, his brilliance was glorious and great — his original intent was fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Shun had given his life for the state; in death his integrity shone clear and grand, and his purpose was fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 遺愛在民，漢、番男婦老幼呼為活佛。

translations.literal: His lingering benevolence remained with the people. Han and Tibetan men and women, old and young, called him a Living Buddha.
translations.idiomatic: The people cherished his memory. Han and Tibetans, young and old alike, called him a living buddha.

sentences.zh: 誤觸其名，即童子皆呵禁之。

translations.literal: Even to touch upon his name by mistake — even children would scold and forbid it.
translations.idiomatic: Even to mention his name in error drew reprimands — even from children.

sentences.zh: 在朝廷為有臣，定安為有子，甘肅為有官。

translations.literal: To the court he was a worthy minister; to Ding An he was a worthy son; to Gansu he was a worthy official.
translations.idiomatic: The court had in him a worthy servant; Ding An had a worthy son; Gansu had a worthy official.

sentences.zh: 闔門全節，允為一代完人，再懇優恤。」

translations.literal: The entire household preserved integrity unto death — truly a complete man of his age. Again we earnestly request exceptional mourning honors.
translations.idiomatic: His entire household died with integrity — he was truly a man of complete virtue for his age. We again urgently request exceptional posthumous honors.

sentences.zh: 光緒初元，陝甘總督左宗棠覆奏，謂：「承順死節奇偉，一時僅見。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang submitted a memorial in reply, saying: 'Cheng Shun's death in loyalty was extraordinarily sublime — rarely seen in his time.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Guangxu reign, Governor-General Zuo Zongtang replied in memorial, saying: 'Cheng Shun's martyrdom was extraordinarily sublime — rarely seen in his time.

sentences.zh: 綱常名義，不因品秩等差而別，則表揚較名位尊顯為尤亟。

translations.literal: The bonds of ethics and righteous duty do not vary according to rank and grade; thus public commendation is even more urgent than the display of high office.
translations.idiomatic: Ethical duty does not rise or fall with official rank, and therefore public commendation matters even more than lofty title.

sentences.zh: 請官為建祠，並予諡法，以勵人心。」

translations.literal: We request that the state build a shrine and grant a posthumous name to encourage the hearts of men.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that the state erect a shrine in his honor and grant a posthumous name to inspire the people.

sentences.zh: 疏上，允之，諡勤愍。

translations.literal: When the memorial reached the throne, it was approved. He was given the posthumous name Qinmin.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved. He was granted the posthumous name Qinmin, 'Diligent and Sorrowful.'

sentences.zh: 托克清阿，字凝如，滿洲正藍旗人。

translations.literal: Tuokiqing'a, courtesy name Ningru, was a Manchu of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Tuokiqing'a, courtesy name Ningru, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 道光十四年舉人，大挑知縣，發甘肅，署環縣、安化知縣，及土魯番同知。

translations.literal: A provincial graduate of the fourteenth year of Daoguang, selected in the grand nomination for magistrate and dispatched to Gansu. He acted as magistrate of Huan County and Anhua, and as sub-prefect of Turfan.
translations.idiomatic: A provincial graduate in the fourteenth year of Daoguang, he was selected in the grand nomination for magistrate and sent to Gansu, where he served as acting magistrate of Huan County and Anhua and as sub-prefect of Turfan.

sentences.zh: 以清查事鐫級。

translations.literal: For matters of inventory investigation his rank was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: For an audit investigation his rank was demoted.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，捐復原官，補皋蘭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng he donated to restore his original rank and was appointed to Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng he purchased restoration of his original rank and was appointed magistrate of Gaolan.

sentences.zh: 時回、捻擾陝、甘，土匪聞風響應。

translations.literal: At that time Muslims and Nian rebels disturbed Shaanxi and Gansu, and local bandits responded at the news.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Muslim and Nian rebels ravaged Shaanxi and Gansu, and local bandits rose in response.

sentences.zh: 侍郎梁瀚治團練，疏薦之。

translations.literal: Vice Minister Liang Han was directing militia training and recommended him in a memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Liang Han, who was organizing militia training, recommended him in a memorial.

sentences.zh: 總督樂斌亦以其任事果敢，檄署秦州直隸州知州，尋實授。

translations.literal: Governor Le Bin also, because he was bold and resolute in affairs, ordered him to act as magistrate of Qinzhou direct prefecture, and soon he received full appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Le Bin also noted his bold competence and appointed him acting magistrate of Qinzhou; he soon received full appointment.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，逆回竄甘南，州境戒嚴，托克清阿募壯勇，繕器械，力籌守禦。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi rebel Muslims raided southern Gansu. The prefecture was placed on alert. Tuokiqing'a recruited stalwart braves, repaired weapons, and strove to organize defense.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi rebel Muslims raided southern Gansu and the prefecture went on alert. Tuokiqing'a recruited stalwart militia, repaired arms, and worked tirelessly to organize the defense.

sentences.zh: 賊竄秦安，率軍迎剿，屢挫賊。

translations.literal: When rebels raided Qin'an he led troops to meet them in suppression and repeatedly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When rebels raided Qin'an he led troops against them and repeatedly drove them back.

sentences.zh: 賊糾大股至，眾寡不敵，力戰死之。

translations.literal: Rebels gathered a large force and arrived. Outnumbered, he fought with all his strength and died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels gathered a large force. Outnumbered, he fought to the end and fell.

sentences.zh: 事聞，詔以道員從優議卹，秦州及本旗立專祠。

translations.literal: When report reached the court, an edict ordered him to receive exceptionally favorable mourning deliberation as a circuit intendant, and exclusive shrines were built at Qinzhou and in his banner.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, an edict ordered exceptionally favorable mourning honors at circuit-intendant rank, and exclusive shrines were erected at Qinzhou and in his banner.

sentences.zh: 後秦州承其規畫，防禦嚴密，境獲安全。

translations.literal: Later Qinzhou followed his plans. Defenses were strict and the territory remained secure.
translations.idiomatic: Later Qinzhou followed his plans; its defenses held firm and the territory remained secure.

sentences.zh: 四年，秦州士民以托克清阿忠貞孝友，慈惠嚴明，潔己愛民，禦災捍患，在任時民皆安業，賊不犯境。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the gentry and people of Qinzhou stated that Tuokiqing'a was loyal, upright, filial, and fraternal, benevolent and strict, clean in person and loving toward the people, guarding against disaster and repelling calamity. While in office the people all lived in peace and the rebels did not violate the borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the gentry and people of Qinzhou reported that Tuokiqing'a was loyal, upright, filial, and fraternal, benevolent yet strict, personally incorruptible and devoted to the people, guarding against disaster and repelling calamity. During his tenure the people lived in peace and rebels did not cross the borders.

sentences.zh: 遺愛餘威，實足固民心而寒賊膽，籥請加恩賜諡。

translations.literal: His lingering benevolence and remaining prestige were truly enough to strengthen the people's hearts and chill the rebels' courage. The people petitioned for additional grace and a posthumous name.
translations.idiomatic: His lingering benevolence and remaining prestige truly strengthened the people's resolve and chilled rebel ardor. The people petitioned for further honors and a posthumous name.

sentences.zh: 總督恩麟據以入告，特詔允之，予諡剛烈。

translations.literal: Governor En Lin reported accordingly to the throne, and a special edict approved it, granting the posthumous name Ganglie.
translations.idiomatic: Governor En Lin relayed the request to the throne, and a special edict approved it, granting the posthumous name Ganglie, 'Firm and Fierce.'

sentences.zh: 馮元吉，字景梅，浙江山陰人。

translations.literal: Feng Yuanji, courtesy name Jingmei, was a native of Shanyin, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yuanji, courtesy name Jingmei, was a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 由供事議敘從九品，分廣西，歷署貴縣五山汛、凌雲平樂司巡檢。

translations.literal: Beginning as a clerk, he was recommended for ninth-rank assistant status, assigned to Guangxi, and successively held acting posts as patrol inspector at Wushan garrison in Gui County and at Pingle station in Lingyun.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning as a clerk, he was recommended for ninth-rank assistant status and assigned to Guangxi, where he served in acting posts as patrol inspector at Wushan garrison in Gui County and at Pingle station in Lingyun.

sentences.zh: 道光二十八年，授宜山龍門巡檢。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Daoguang he received appointment as patrol inspector at Longmen in Yishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year of Daoguang he was appointed patrol inspector at Longmen in Yishan.

sentences.zh: 咸豐元年，金田賊由武宣東鄉逃竄，都統烏蘭泰、提督向榮、總兵秦定三等節節追剿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianfeng the Jintian rebels fled east from Wuxuan. General Uriangga, Regional Commander Xiang Rong, and Brigade Commander Qin Dingsan pursued step by step.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianfeng the Jintian rebels fled east from Wuxuan. General Uriangga, Regional Commander Xiang Rong, and Brigade Commander Qin Dingsan pursued them step by step.

sentences.zh: 賊竄象州，兵勇不能禦，直至大樂墟，轉掠龍門。

translations.literal: The rebels raided into Xiangzhou; troops could not stop them and they pressed as far as Daleixu, then turned to plunder Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels raided into Xiangzhou. Troops could not stop them, and they pressed as far as Daleixu before turning to plunder Longmen.

sentences.zh: 元吉率鄉兵御之，戰敗，馳回署，衣冠坐堂皇，二子澍、溥侍立。

translations.literal: Yuanji led local militia to resist. Defeated in battle, he galloped back to his office, dressed in official robes and cap and seated in the main hall, while his two sons Shu and Pu stood in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanji led local militia to resist. After defeat he galloped back to his office, dressed in official robes and cap, and seated himself in the main hall while his two sons Shu and Pu stood at his side.

sentences.zh: 家人請暫避，元吉厲聲曰：「身為命官，不能殺賊安民，走避偷生，吾不為也！」

translations.literal: His household asked him to withdraw temporarily. Yuanji said sternly: 'As an appointed official, if I cannot kill rebels and secure the people, fleeing to save my life — I will not do it!
translations.idiomatic: His household urged him to withdraw for the moment. Yuanji said sternly: 'As an appointed official, if I cannot kill rebels and secure the people, I will not flee to save my own life!

sentences.zh: 麾二子出，皆痛哭不去。

translations.literal: He ordered his two sons out, but both wept bitterly and would not leave.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his two sons to leave, but both wept bitterly and refused to go.

sentences.zh: 賊至，父子抗罵，同遇害。

translations.literal: When the rebels arrived, father and sons resisted with curses and all perished together.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels arrived, father and sons defied them with curses and all perished together.

sentences.zh: 家丁嚴祿、夏玉俱死。

translations.literal: Household servants Yan Lu and Xia Yu also died.
translations.idiomatic: The household servants Yan Lu and Xia Yu also died.

sentences.zh: 詔以元吉微員，從容盡節，澍、溥從父殉難，忠孝堪嘉。

translations.literal: An edict stated that though Yuanji was a minor official, he met death with composure; Shu and Pu followed their father in martyrdom — filial piety and loyalty worthy of praise.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated that though Yuanji was a minor official, he met death with composure, and that Shu and Pu followed their father in martyrdom — an act of filial piety and loyalty worthy of praise.

sentences.zh: 贈鹽運使司知事銜，賞世職，建專祠，澍、溥附祀。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted the rank of Salt Transport Commissioner secretary, awarded a hereditary office, and given an exclusive shrine; Shu and Pu were enshrined with him.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the rank of Salt Transport Commissioner secretary, awarded a hereditary office, and given an exclusive shrine with Shu and Pu enshrined alongside him.

sentences.zh: 平源，字沛霖，順天大興籍，浙江山陰人。

translations.literal: Ping Yuan, courtesy name Peilin, was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, and a native of Shanyin, Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ping Yuan, courtesy name Peilin, was registered in Daxing, Shuntian, though a native of Shanyin in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 由吏員敘典史，發安徽。

translations.literal: Through clerical service he was recommended for the post of county archivist and dispatched to Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: From clerical service he was recommended as county archivist and dispatched to Anhui.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年，署懷寧縣典史，卹獄囚，嘗曰：「囚死於法，可也；

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianfeng he held acting post as archivist of Huaining County. He showed compassion to prisoners in the jail, and often said: 'Prisoners may die by law — that is acceptable;
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianfeng he served as acting archivist of Huaining County. He showed compassion to prisoners and often said: 'Prisoners may die by law — that is acceptable;

sentences.zh: 死於非法，不可也。」

translations.literal: to die unlawfully — that is not acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: but to die unlawfully — that is not acceptable.

sentences.zh: 眠食皆躬察之。

translations.literal: He personally inspected their sleep and meals.
translations.idiomatic: He personally inspected their sleeping and eating conditions.

sentences.zh: 粵匪犯安慶，事急，囚譁，欲脫械去。

translations.literal: When Cantonese rebels attacked Anqing the situation grew urgent. The prisoners clamored and wished to cast off their shackles and flee.
translations.idiomatic: When Cantonese rebels attacked Anqing the situation grew urgent. The prisoners clamored and tried to cast off their shackles and flee.

sentences.zh: 源至，囚曰：「此何時也，公胡弗自便？」

translations.literal: Yuan arrived, and a prisoner said: 'At a time like this, why do you not save yourself?
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan arrived, a prisoner said: 'At a time like this, why do you not save yourself?

sentences.zh: 源曰：「此若輩所以犯刑也，死可苟免耶？」

translations.literal: Yuan said: 'This is why you people violated the law. Can death be evaded so casually?
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said: 'This is why you violated the law. Can death be evaded so casually?

sentences.zh: 囚曰：「公不去，囚何忍去？」

translations.literal: The prisoner said: 'If you do not leave, how can we prisoners bear to leave?
translations.idiomatic: The prisoner said: 'If you will not leave, how can we prisoners bear to leave?

sentences.zh: 俄而城陷，巡撫蔣文慶遇害，餘官皆走。

translations.literal: Before long the city fell; Governor Jiang Wenqing was killed and the remaining officials all fled.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the city fell. Governor Jiang Wenqing was killed and the remaining officials all fled.

sentences.zh: 源獨冠服坐獄門外，賊至，脅之曰：「若降，官；

translations.literal: Yuan alone put on cap and robes and sat outside the prison gate. When the rebels arrived they threatened him: 'If you submit, you shall have office;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan alone put on his cap and robes and sat outside the prison gate. When the rebels arrived they threatened him: 'Submit and you shall have office;

sentences.zh: 若不然，飲吾刃！」

translations.literal: If not, drink my blade!
translations.idiomatic: If not, taste my blade!

sentences.zh: 源曰：「刃則刃耳，吾豈受汝脅者？」

translations.literal: Yuan said: 'A blade is a blade — am I one to be coerced by you?
translations.idiomatic: Yuan said: 'A blade is a blade — do you think I can be coerced by you?

sentences.zh: 賊曳至懷寧縣署外殺之，逮死罵不絕口。

translations.literal: The rebels dragged him outside the Huaining county yamen and killed him. Until death he cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels dragged him outside the Huaining county yamen and killed him. He cursed without cease until he died.

sentences.zh: 安慶人思之，為立石於殉節處。

translations.literal: The people of Anqing remembered him and erected a stone at the place of his martyrdom.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Anqing remembered him and erected a stone at the place where he died.

sentences.zh: 時又有張寶華者，為望江縣典史。

translations.literal: At that time there was also Zhang Baohua, who served as archivist of Wangjiang County.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was also Zhang Baohua, archivist of Wangjiang County.

sentences.zh: 聞城陷，視其妻賈氏自經畢，冠服坐堂上罵賊，死。

translations.literal: When he heard the city had fallen, he saw that his wife Lady Jia had finished hanging herself, then put on cap and robes, sat in the main hall cursing the rebels, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard the city had fallen, he saw that his wife Lady Jia had already hanged herself, then put on cap and robes, sat in the main hall cursing the rebels, and died.

sentences.zh: 華陽鎮巡檢王泗同時殉難，盱眙縣典史週來豫後於九年助守縣城，力戰墜馬死。

translations.literal: Wang Si, patrol inspector of Huayang town, died at the same time. Zhou Laiyu, archivist of Xuyi County, later in the ninth year assisted in defending the county seat, fought with all his strength, fell from his horse, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Si, patrol inspector of Huayang town, died at the same time. Zhou Laiyu, archivist of Xuyi County, later in the ninth year helped defend the county seat, fought with all his strength, fell from his horse, and died.

sentences.zh: 餘寶錕，江西德化人。

translations.literal: Yu Baokun was a native of Dehua, Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Baokun was a native of Dehua in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 附貢生，捐知縣，

translations.literal: An attached tribute student, he purchased the appointment of magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: An attached tribute student, he purchased appointment as magistrate.

sentences.zh: 選授浙江景寧縣，以才力不及降調。

translations.literal: He was selected and appointed to Jingning County in Zhejiang, but was demoted for insufficient ability.
translations.idiomatic: He was selected and appointed magistrate of Jingning County in Zhejiang, but was demoted for insufficient ability.

sentences.zh: 复捐縣丞，發貴州。

translations.literal: Again he purchased appointment as county assistant and was sent to Guizhou.
